# Q-049: INV-USD-1, 2,720.00 USD, paid 3,000.00 USD into Wise USD, which
# leaves 280.00 USD on the receivable as the customer's credit. A book keeping
# cost bases opens a cost basis for that credit at the invoice's cost, since
# nothing in a payment stated in US dollars says what the dollars cost.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_book_can_keep_no_cost_bases.py.
invoice "INV-USD-1"
	customer_id: "C-USD"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-07-31
	entry:
		date: 2026-07-31
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 2720
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-07-31
		due: 2026-08-30
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD-1"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-08-13
		amount: 3000
		account: "Assets:Wise USD"
		memo: "Received money from Example Customer Inc"
